title: Non-blocking owner questions are asked in the relay ledger and read back before the finish step
lead: When a role raises an `[owner]` finding that does not block, ork asks it in the relay ledger at once with `relay-run ask` and no `--blocker`, so the step keeps running. It writes the owner's answer through to the ledger, and reads any answer given there before the card is built and before the finish step.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Split out of S204 (owner, 2026-10-31): S204 is already M, and this rule adds slicer calls, a record field and a read-back. The v11 rule: "Ask an owner question that does not block as soon as it arises, with the same command without `--blocker`. It records the question and leaves your step running ... Before the closing note and the finish step, read each with `slicer relay-run answer RUN QUESTION_ID --get`; an answer that changes the slice goes to the implementer as a fix round first. A question still open then goes on the report's owner-needed line" (`slicer ai relay-orchestrator`, Owner questions). S198's notes say the same (2) and ask that ork not treat it as a wait.

Traced against HEAD of main on 2026-10-31:

- `RelayAsk` always passes `--blocker` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:320-322`). Its one caller mirrors a paused question, which is a wait, so `--blocker` is right there (`internal/engine/ledger.go:35`).
- A non-blocking owner finding is kept in `findings[]` and never reaches the ledger (`internal/engine/later.go:36-62`, called at `internal/engine/round.go:509`). The owner answers it in ork with `AnswerFinding` (`internal/engine/later.go:147-188`), which records the answer in the run record and, with a decision key, in adj. A dashboard that reads the ledger sees no such question, and an answer given there is never read.
- `slicer relay-run ask` without `--blocker` records the question and leaves the step running; `relay-run answer RUN QID --get --json` prints `{run, step, question}` where `question.answer` is null or `{option, text, why, by}` (`../slicer/src/slicer/cli.py:813-838`, `../slicer/src/slicer/relayrun.py:277-300`). ork already decodes this shape as `slicercli.LedgerQuestion` (`internal/slicercli/types.go:243-254`).
- The finish step is the point after which no ledger step is recorded (`internal/engine/states.go:663-689`, `endRelay` at the end of `finish`), so a question asked after a commit is skipped, as `ownerWait` skips it (`internal/engine/ledger.go:30-32`).
- An answer that "changes the slice goes to the implementer as a fix round first": ork has the owner's fix action on the approval card (`docs/design.md:586-600`). The owner sees an answered or open finding on the card before approving, so this slice records the ledger answer on the finding and leaves the fix decision to the owner. Open owner question Q4 in the manifest asks whether that is enough.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRelayAskWithoutBlockerOmitsTheFlag` and `TestRelayAskBlockerPassesTheFlag` (`internal/slicercli/write_test.go`): the argv of `relay-run ask RUN --step S --title T --option ... --json` has no `--blocker` for `false` and has it right after `--title T` for `true`. Fails first: the signature has no `blocker` argument (compile error), then the flag is always present.
- `TestRelayAnswerGetReadsTheQuestion`: `RelayAnswerGet` runs `relay-run answer RUN QID --get --json --root ROOT`, passes no `--option`, `--text`, `--why` or `--by`, is not logged as a write (`TestReadsAreNotWrites`, `:307`, shows how), and returns the `LedgerQuestion` with `Answer` nil for an open question and `{option: "keep"}` for an answered one.
- `TestFindingLedgerQuestionRoundTrips` (`internal/runrec/runrec_test.go`): a finding with `ledger_question` survives save and load; a `run.json` without the field still loads.
- `TestNonBlockingOwnerFindingIsAskedInTheLedgerWithoutBlocker` (`internal/engine/ledger_findings_test.go`): a v11 run whose reviewer raises `ownerFinding` (`internal/engine/kinds_report_test.go:15`) makes one `relay-run ask` call on the orchestrator step with the finding's title and options, no `--blocker`, and with `--key` when the finding has one; `rec.Findings[0].LedgerQuestion` is the id the fake slicer returned; no `--phase wait` call is made on the orchestrator step for it. Fails first: no ask call is made.
- `TestSameOwnerFindingIsAskedOnce`: the same title raised in a later round adds no second ask.
- `TestOwnerFindingAskIsAdvisory`: a failing `relay-run ask` leaves the finding without an id and the run reaching approval.
- `TestPausedQuestionStillAsksWithBlocker`: the existing `TestOwnerQuestionPauseRecordsOwnerWaitAndAsk` also asserts `--blocker`. It passes today and guards the signature change.
- `TestNoLedgerAskAfterTheCommit`: a finding raised by a landing fix round (`rec.Commit != nil`) makes no ask call.
- `TestAnswerFindingWritesTheLedgerAnswer`: `AnswerFinding(1, "keep", "jon")` on a finding with an id runs `relay-run answer RUN q1 --text keep --by jon`; with no id, no answer call. Fails first: no call.
- `TestLedgerAnswerIsReadBeforeTheCard`: the fake slicer answers `relay-run answer RUN q1 --get` with an answered question (`option` `keep`); at gate PASS the finding has `Answer` `keep` and a non-zero `AnsweredAt`, and no answer write call was made. Fails first: nothing reads it.
- `TestLedgerAnswerIsReadAgainAtTheFinishStep`: the question is answered between the card and approval; after `Approve` the finding holds the answer before the finish role runs.
- `TestOpenLedgerQuestionStaysOpen`: `--get` gives `answer: null`; the finding stays unanswered and no error is raised.
- `TestLedgerReadFailureIsAdvisory`: `--get` exits non-zero; the run goes on.
- `TestAnswerFromTheLedgerIsNotFiledInAdj`: a ledger-read answer on a finding with a decision key makes no `adj decide` call (the owner's answer in ork, `AnswerFinding`, still does).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first; watch each go red for the reason given.

1. Re-anchor every cited line in the worktree. Run `slicer relay-run ask --help` and `slicer relay-run answer --help` and check the flags this slice uses (`--blocker`, `--get`).
2. Preflight: Q4 in the manifest (scope: ask plus write-through plus read-back, or the ask and write-through only, or not at all). The outer session records the answer as an `Owner decisions` paragraph. Steps 3 to 6 follow the recommended scope (all three); if the answer drops the read-back, skip step 5.
3. `internal/slicercli/write.go`: add the `blocker bool` argument to `RelayAsk`; pass `--blocker` only when true. Add `RelayAnswerGet(ctx, root, run, question) (*LedgerQuestion, error)` as a read (`c.call(...)` and `clirun.RunJSON`, not `c.write`): `relay-run answer RUN QID --get --json --root ROOT`, decoding `{"question": {...}}`. Update `ledger.go`'s caller to pass `true`.
4. `internal/runrec/record.go`: add the `LedgerQuestion` field to `Finding`. The record version stays 1 (the field is `omitempty`). An older ork that does not know it refuses a `run.json` that has it, as for `scores` and `answer` (`docs/state.md:327-329`); say so in the docs.
5. `internal/engine`: (a) in `recordFindings`, after the update that keeps new findings, ask each newly added owner finding that has an `Ask` through `askFinding` in `ledger.go`: skip when the run has no ledger run or orchestrator step or `rec.Commit != nil` (the same guard as `ownerWait`), call `RelayAsk(..., false)` with the finding's key and question, and store the id on the finding in a second `run.Update`; make the calls after the first update, outside any held lock, and ignore a failed call (recording is advisory). (b) In `AnswerFinding`, after the record is updated, call `RelayAnswer` with `Text: text, By: by` when the finding has an id and `rec.Commit == nil`; ignore its error. (c) `syncLedgerAnswers(ctx)` in `ledger.go`: for each owner finding with an id and no answer, call `RelayAnswerGet`; when `question.Answer` is set, store `option` (else `text`) as `Answer` and `question.AnsweredAt` parsed as `AnsweredAt` (the current time when it does not parse) in the record, without any adj call. Call it before `buildCard` at `states.go:557` and at the top of `finish` (`states.go:663`); skip when `rec.Commit != nil`. A finding answered in ork is never overwritten.
6. Docs: `docs/design.md` (non-blocking findings are asked in the ledger without a wait, the answer is written through, and read at the card and before the finish step; a ledger-read answer is not filed in adj), `docs/state.md` (`ledger_question`), `docs/orchestrator-parity.md` row 4.2. Refer to slicer's commands; do not paste the contract. Mark the behavior *proposed*.
7. CHANGELOG last, so a parallel slice's entry does not conflict: one bullet under `## Unreleased`, "S###:" of this slice's id, *proposed*.

Do not change `round.go`, the TUI, the daemon or adj filing. No new dependency. SPDX header on the new test file.

Not a UI slice by its Files: no UI pass.

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): Who runs the three Check lines the implementer's allowlist does not cover? -> runnable: replace them with forms the implementer's sandbox can run. For the narrow test run, use `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/slicercli ./internal/runrec ./internal/engine`, which exits 0. For the grep, use `rg -c -- '--blocker' internal/slicercli/write.go`, which prints a count; the implementer's allowlist did not cover the original `rg -n "blocker"` line..

sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestRelayAsk|TestRelayAnswerGet|TestFindingLedger|TestNonBlocking|TestSameOwner|TestOwnerFinding|TestPausedQuestion|TestNoLedgerAsk|TestAnswerFinding|TestLedgerAnswer|TestOpenLedger|TestLedgerRead|TestAnswerFromTheLedger' ./internal/slicercli ./internal/runrec ./internal/engine` passes.
- `rg -n "blocker" internal/slicercli/write.go` shows `--blocker` added only under the flag.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] After landing and an `ork daemon restart` (the owner rebuilds `~/bin/ork` first), a relay whose reviewer raises an `[owner]` finding shows the question in `slicer relay-run list RUN` with the orchestrator step still running, and `slicer relay-run answer RUN QID --option LABEL` is visible on the finding in ork before approval.
